The most important thing:

Recognize that upvotes do not mean agreement, and downvotes do not mean disagreement.

Voting simply indicates how visible you want a piece of content to be.

Nobody can tell you how to vote

Yeah I'm about to myself, but these are just suggestions. If you think different voting strategies will improve Voat, feel free to try them. But I implore you not to simply vote on agreement/disagreement in order to avoid hive-mind tendencies from overwhelming the site and turning it into a circle-jerk.

How to vote on submissions.

Voting should be used to indicate how much a submission contributes to a given subverse.

Down vote submissions that don't belong in the sub they are posted in (Even if you agree with their sentiment or like the content)

Up vote submissions that meaningfully contribute quality content to the sub they are in; ESPECIALLY if you disagree with their message. Increasing the visibility of viewpoints you disagree with might allow others to effectively counter it in the comments.

How to vote on comments

Voting should be used to indicate how much a given comment contributes to the discussion of a post.

Down vote comments that are off topic or otherwise do not contribute to relevant discussion of the post.

Up vote comments that meaningfully contribute to the discussion; ESPECIALLY if you disagree with their message. Increasing the the visibility of arguments you disagree with will encourage others to effectively counter it rather than just silencing it. Down voting comments you disagree with is like sticking your fingers in your ears saying "na na na I can't hear you."

Thanks for reading.

Lesser Gods would have limited scope in their nature.

Greater gods would have absolute power over their aspect/domain, however they could then be less involved in the daily lives of the species of mortal beings that exist, out of choice.

Lesser gods could have power over specialized areas, however due to their natures, the power itself may be subject to the will of greater gods. Lesser gods are still powerful, however they tend to have some need to alter the pathways of mortals and nurture their own aspects into the creatures they favor. Demigods are immortal, and yet could be alive in a body in the world of Gaea, or some other plane. Demigods tend to rule whole civilizations or specialized groups devoted to their cause, and have very powerful magic and skills in the areas that relate to their aspect.
